# Recipes & where to get things
[textlink="Back to Mining & Industry" link="CMUGuideIndustry"]
[bold]What are we building?[/bold] Search for an item, material or machine. Click a material or equipment sprite to see how to make it, where it drops, or which machine produces it. Use Back to return to your project.
Pick a production method, then choose how many batches to pack for. Tools and molds marked [bold]kept[/bold] are reusable. Gathering cards show possible sources; drops and deposits can vary.
[bold]Ready to make it?[/bold] Hand recipes: carry the supplies and right-click yourself → Craft. Machine recipes: use the listed equipment and follow the card's instructions. The planner shows base quantities; crafting challenges and machine speed can change the result or time.
